definitions.ask: Regenerate the real-bob directive fixtures from current bob instead of hand-editing their grammar?
definitions.why: A trial regeneration changed only grammar, a null drawer, and one template preview

choices.label: Rerun the generator on bob-cli master; 66 one-line diffs, fixtures stay truthful
Hand-set grammar 5 in three clip parse fixtures; smallest diff, but no longer real output

definitions.ask: Move every inline fake-bob body that hard-codes grammar 3 to grammar 5?
definitions.why: fake-bob simulates current bob; gate tests use injected grammar, never a literal 3

choices.label: Bump all 67 literal grammar-3 bodies to match the injected default 5
Bump only the ^sase:deep-fix and @file:ready bodies the failing tests hit

definitions.ask: Restore legacy Pull-In section order when Bob lists only some groups and sends no copy?
definitions.why: Current bob lists every group with copy, so only older payloads change

choices.label: Fix CapturePullInChoice so keep-moving ranks last again for copy-less partial lists
Keep always-Bob-order and rewrite the test to expect keep-moving first

definitions.ask: Keep AppKit's native caret placement after undoing Ctrl-G U?
definitions.why: The documented contract is native undo, and AppKit leaves the caret at {5,0}

choices.label: Drop the post-undo caret assertion, as docs/keyboard.md promises native undo
Register selection restoration so undo returns the caret to its pre-toggle spot
